messages:
anya: FYI we got a flagged report from Orion (hw partner) — several customers show usage in their portal but no entitlements in our marketplace records. Looks like repeated incremental replays from their end created duplicate/no-op events and some windows dropped. cc @kevin @lia :eyes:
kevin: ugh, do we have specific customer IDs or sample payloads?
anya: They sent 3 examples in the ticket: CUST-2201, CUST-3310, CUST-4477. Payload attached in ticket, but here's a sanitized sample:
anya: ```
{
  "customer_id":"CUST-2201",
  "usage": 12000,
  "window_start":"2025-11-01T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end":"2025-11-01T23:59:59Z",
  "event_id":"evt-9f8b-20251101",
  "replay": true
}
```
maria: looks like idempotency keys are missing or inconsistent from Orion. Without stable event_id/idempotency we can't dedupe replayed batches. Also timezone normalization mismatch — their window_end sometimes sent as local tz.
josh: we already have a replay detector in the metering ingestion service but its TTL is 48h. If Orion is replaying older windows, it falls out of cache and we accept duplicates as new buckets.
lia: Orion says they only keep 7 days of history and do incremental replays nightly. They expected our reconciliation to pick up missing entitlements automatically.
kevin: immediate plan: 1) run a targeted backfill for the affected windows & customers 2) extend replay-dedup TTL to 14 days 3) ask Orion to include an idempotency header/event_id format and consistent UTC timestamps
recon-bot: scheduled job created: "marketplace.recon.backfill" for CUST-2201,CUST-3310,CUST-4477 at 2025-11-04T16:00:00Z
maria: for backfill we should do a dry-run first and produce a reconciliation diff CSV (external_id, reported_usage, recorded_usage, delta). I'll own the dry-run.
anya: can we add a canary step? run backfill for CUST-2201 only, verify invoices and entitlements, then expand.
josh: yes. I'll spin up a one-off backfill worker. Suggest flags: --dry-run --canary-customer=CUST-2201 --max-ops=5000
lia: I'll notify Orion about the idempotency requirement and request UTC in the payload. I'll include their dev contact and example schema.
kevin: long-term we should implement a reconciliation playbook for partners that do incremental replays: - require stable event_id - accept a replay boolean + original_event_ts - server-side dedupe window configurable per partner - signed webhook with HMAC
kevin: also add partner-level setting: replay_ttl_days (default 14) and a manual "force-reconcile" endpoint for partner-eng to trigger backfills :thumbsup:
maria: quick note on implementation: we already persist raw payloads in s3 with path partner=orion/date=... so backfill can reprocess originals if available. If not, we'll compute deltas from reports vs. aggregated usage table.
anya: timeline? can we have canary dry-run results by EOD?
josh: I can kick the canary dry-run now, will post results here in ~2h.
lia: I'll send Orion the schema + ask them to stop replaying until we agree on idempotency.
anya: thanks team. action items: @maria dry-run diff + CSV, @josh run canary, @lia vendor coord, @kevin update partner settings roadmap. Follow-up sync at 2025-11-05 09:30 PT if needed.
kevin: noted, I'll add to roadmap and open a tiny RFC for partner replay contract.
recon-bot: backfill dry-run started (job id bf-20251104-33)
anya: marking this thread as the canonical record for this incident. If Orion agrees we'll document the playbook in partnerships runbook repo. :white_check_mark:
